abstention.description: Explicit semantic abstention for a plausible task. Absence of a candidate is not automatically an abstention, and processing failures are represented elsewhere.

deferredRecordResolution.description: Non-authoritative disposition proposed for one deterministic Phase B deferred record. The proposal is validated separately and is not an adjudication or graph-acceptance outcome.

evidenceSpan.description: One contiguous evidence span. A span may not cross a source-unit boundary.

evidenceHash.description: Pipeline-computed SHA-256 of UTF-8(evidenceText); null before evidence validation.
